extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, former USPTO-registered practitioners, and parties filing petitions for reinstatement before the USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision on a Petition for Reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, including supporting affidavits and supplementary filings under 37 CFR § 11.58.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Dean J. Tricarico dated January 17, 2014, and the supplementary information dated February 6, 2014 and April 11, 2014.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition must be filed (with dates noted) and may be accompanied by supplementary information; the petition and any supplements are the primary materials reviewed by the Director in deciding reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Tricarico has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is submitted as supporting evidence for a reinstatement petition; inclusion of such an affidavit is treated as a material part of the petition record for the Director's review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Careful review by the Director of Enrollment and Discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, and the supporting affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Tricarico to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director evaluates the petition and supporting materials and exercises discretion to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate based on the submitted record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Granting of Petition / Reinstatement outcome
rubrics_metrics.description: Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the Director determines reinstatement is appropriate, an order granting the petition is issued; the decision and any notice are provided to the petitioner (copy to named recipient).
